action: Root loading wired into16segments and home; unreferenced partner loading-shell removed. Recovery copy saved as partner-loading-shell-before-removal.txt, no native loading boundary reintroduced.

issue: The URL alone drives the success state (submitted=verification_required) and the error state (registrationRetry=...). The state persists on reload and Back, and anyone can share it.
action: Verified success remains bound to short-lived result proof. Absent valid draft, old/shared error URL now gives an explicitly unconfirmed result and warns against duplicate submission instead of claiming failure. Known draft retains precise failure feedback. One-time flash consumption is not implemented.

issue: The form now contains hidden formId, landingPageId, funnelStepId, liveId, redirectTo and __registrationReturnPath fields. Unlike lead-form, the diff shows no matching change that filters these out of the JS answer payload.
reason: Actual submit handler explicitly maps submission.form.fields to payload; no Object.fromEntries of whole FormData. See src/components/landing-pages/funnel-page-document-renderer.tsx submit function.

issue: After a native 303 the error appears in the initial HTML. aria-live and role=alert regions present at load are generally not announced, no focus is moved, and fields aren't linked with aria-invalid/aria-describedby. Also, only the webinar consumer visibly uses the shared RegistrationSubmissionFeedback; the shown diff doesn't confirm that lead-form and the funnel renderer use the same live-region markup.
reason: All three consumers share feedback. Chromium/Firefox JS submit errors focus role=alert in current /form regression. No-JS visible markup verified; human AT announcement and field-specific association remain unverified. No blanket aria-invalid applied to unrelated fields.

issue: A single formId (`page.submissionForm?.id ?? page.webinar?.form.id`) is chosen for every branch. The webinar branch, however, renders resource.form.id.
action: Both root and step select webinar.form.id only for webinar goal; generic branches use submissionForm.id. Dual-form regression failed before repair and now passes.
additional_test_scope: snapshot-binding-targeted.json includes both pages AND changed test file; binding-targeted-receipt.json PASS

issue: sourcePath is built from unencoded values that don't match each other: the raw params slug/stepPath in the step page versus page.slug at the root. redirectTo, by contrast, uses encodeURIComponent(page.slug).
action: Step sourcePath now uses canonical page.slug and step.path. Mixed-case input regression PASS. Existing pageSlug/pathPattern contracts allow lowercase ASCII alphanumeric and hyphens only; no unsupported non-ASCII route expansion.

issue: `redirectTo ?? retry?.sourcePath` keeps an empty-string redirectTo while the guard uses `||`. Also, defaulting redirectTo to sourcePath changes the native success destination for forms that had none before.
action: Empty redirectTo now falls back to retry.sourcePath using ||; undefined/empty/explicit destination matrix PASS. Return to source is intentional native feedback behavior.
